rule.metrics: trades by entry day; net after recorded charges; drawdown over closed trades in exit order
rule.min_trades: max(4, ceil(0.25 * sessions in the slice))
rule.fitness: (net - best day) / max(max drawdown, 1000); below min trades: -5 + trades / min; ties: net, then key
rule.G_verdict: a strategy's filter helps only if its walk-forward picks' out-of-sample net (F1-F4 tests) beats the unfiltered strategy on the same sessions and its worst out-of-sample day is no worse
rule.F_verdict: fades work only if the walk-forward fade picks' out-of-sample net is > 0, at least 2 of the 3 multi-session folds (F1-F3) are > 0, and it beats the NULL track's picks out of sample
rule.S_verdict: a smart book helps only if its walk-forward picks' out-of-sample net beats both SHIPPED and UNION on the same sessions with no out-of-sample day worse than Rs -5,000
rule.candidate: the FINAL fold's picks are forward-test candidates only (panel D); nothing is promoted on seen data, and nothing changes the paper or live books in the proving week

seen: every session was seen by O27-O28; Oct 28 prompted this study
